source_summary: A vertical ink landscape with layered misty mountains, rivers and ponds, small pavilion/village clusters, bridges, dense pine groves, rocky foreground banks, and soft monochrome washes with occasional warm color staining near the lower left. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded.

motifs.name: central_striated_peak
motifs.description: Isolate the dominant central mountain peak rising above the composition, including its rounded summit, cascading vertical ink-wash ridges, dark dotted vegetation bands, and adjacent mist-softened shoulders, but excluding the pavilions on the lower slope.
must_preserve: arched parallel ridge contours
dark moss-dot rows along ridge crests
soft grey wash gradients down the slopes
misty lower edges where the mountain dissolves
rounded summit silhouette

motifs.name: left_misty_lake_hills
motifs.description: Isolate the left middle-distance lake basin with low hills, pale water channels, distant tree line, and fog-veiled mountain slopes behind it.
must_preserve: faint layered hill silhouettes
horizontal water wash lines
thin dark tree strokes along the shore
misty transitions between water and slopes
granular dry-brush texture on the low ridges

motifs.name: central_slope_pavilions
motifs.description: Isolate the small group of stepped buildings nestled on the central mountain slope, including pale roof planes, dark roof edges, terrace-like ledges, and surrounding shrub dots, without taking the whole mountain mass.
must_preserve: stacked roof geometry
fine ink outlines of walls and eaves
small terrace ledges
dark shrub and tree dots around the structures
mist-softened connection to the hillside

motifs.name: lower_left_lakeside_village
motifs.description: Isolate the compact lakeside village at the lower left, including clustered houses with pitched roofs, the rocky bank behind them, sparse trees, and the adjacent calm water edge.
must_preserve: individual pitched-roof outlines
thin wall linework
dark shrub dots around the settlement
horizontal water strokes beside the bank
rocky mound texture behind the houses

motifs.name: central_pine_grove_valley
motifs.description: Isolate the dense central valley grove of tall pines and slender trees with small cottages at their base, set among rounded hills and dark vegetation dots.
must_preserve: vertical pine trunks
needle clusters and dark treetops
fine branch marks
small roof forms partly hidden by trees
rounded hill washes and dotted undergrowth

motifs.name: right_arch_bridge_stream
motifs.description: Isolate the right middle-ground arched bridge over a narrow stream, with nearby banks, low rocks, small trees, and the water path curving through the valley.
must_preserve: arched bridge silhouette
short vertical railing or support strokes
curving pale water channel
ink-dark bank edges
small rock and shrub accents around the crossing

motifs.name: lower_right_pine_pavilion_island
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-right rocky island with tall pines and a small pavilion tucked beside them, surrounded by water and steep bank edges.
must_preserve: tall pine trunks with dark needle masses
small pavilion roof and wall outline
rounded boulders at the island base
dark moss-dot clusters
horizontal water strokes around the island

motifs.name: foreground_water_rock_bank
motifs.description: Isolate the broad foreground water surface and rocky banks across the lower portion, including low boulders, shoreline shrubs, reflections, and the warm ochre-stained rock or bank at the lower left.
must_preserve: horizontal ink wash lines on the water
rounded foreground boulders
dark shoreline vegetation dots
soft reflections and pale water gaps
subtle warm ochre color accent on the left bank

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
